QuestInfo.name: I: To the Ends of the World
QuestInfo.2:
Those shock waves that Pepper mentioned in Tynerum...\r\nWhat could be causing them? What's beyond the Tynerum barrier? As you pondered those questions, you received a message from #p1101002#.\r\n#p1101002# sent you an invitation to #m130000000#, on behalf of the Empress.\r\nIn #m130000000#, the Empress revealed something rather horrifying.\r\nShe said the shock waves were getting stronger because the barrier was getting weaker. She wasn't sure what would happen to Maple World if the barrier were to completely disappear...\r\nShe asked you to venture past the barrier to see what you could discover. You agreed, eager to conquer the unknown.

Neinheart called you to Ereve for an urgent meeting.
The Empress asked to look into this new land, and propose a peaceful alliance if possible. 
You traveled to the southernmost tip of Shadow Veil Forest, but you didn't find anything strange until you met an old man named #b#e#p9390200##k#n. 
Once you'd located his missing Emerald, he told you about the continent of #e#bDawnveil#k#n. It sounded like a call to adventure.
Dawnveil, the lost continent... #p9390200# offered to send you there, and it was then you were sure this was the land the Empress had spoken of. A new adventure was just around the bend...
